thinking:
"家味餐厅" (Home Taste Restaurant).
Hangzhou, Zhejiang cuisine, family-style restaurant.
Local families, office workers, tourists.
Home, Menu (with prices), About (story), Reservations (form).
Attract customers to visit or book.
Desktop-first (1440px), responsive, professional, self-contained (no external CSS/JS), simplified Chinese.

    *   *Home (index.html):* Hero section with a welcoming image placeholder/description, brief intro, highlight dishes, call to action (CTA) to the menu or booking.
    *   *Menu (menu.html):* Categorized Zhejiang cuisine (Appetizers, Main Course, Staples, Desserts), prices, and descriptions.
    *   *About (about.html):* The "story" of the restaurant, philosophy (home-cooked feel), location details.
    *   *Reservations (reservations.html):* A clean form for date, time, number of people, and contact info.

    *   *Color Palette:* Warm tones (deep red, cream, gold/beige) to evoke a sense of home and tradition.
    *   *Typography:* Standard sans-serif (PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei) for clarity.
    *   *Navigation:* Simple top nav bar.
    *   *Layout:* Centered container (max-width: 1200px).

    *   *Menu items:* 西湖醋鱼 (West Lake Vinegar Fish), 龙井虾仁 (Longjing Shrimp), 东坡肉 (Dongpo Pork), 杭州焖面 (Hangzhou Braised Noodles).
    *   *About story:* Started by a couple wanting to share authentic Hangzhou flavors; focusing on "home-style" quality.

    *   *CSS:* Embedded in `<style>` tags. Use Flexbox/Grid for layout.
    *   *JS:* Simple form handling (prevent default submission) to simulate a working form.
